subject: social
name: Social Studies
title: Grade 10 Social Studies: Modern World History
overview: Grade 10 Social Studies prepares young citizens for active democratic participation and global engagement through rigorous historical, political, geographic, and economic inquiry.
competencies: Evaluate complex primary sources, detecting bias, corroborating claims, and synthesizing context.
Analyze constitutional principles, governmental structures, and civil liberties in a democratic republic.
Apply macroeconomic principles, market mechanics, and fiscal/monetary policies to public issues.
Deliberate contemporary global policy dilemmas using evidence-based civic discourse.

modules.title: The Enlightenment, Political Revolutions & Nationalism (1750–1850)
modules.description: Analyzing Enlightenment political philosophy, the American, French, and Haitian Revolutions, and the rise of nationalism.

topics.title: Enlightenment Thinkers and Social Contract Theory
topics.description: Analyzing the ideas of Locke, Rousseau, Voltaire, and Montesquieu challenging absolute monarchy.

topics.title: The French and Haitian Revolutions
topics.description: Comparing the storming of the Bastille and the Reign of Terror with Toussaint Louverture's slave revolution in Saint-Domingue.

modules.title: The Industrial Revolution & Global Imperialism (1750–1914)
modules.description: Examining factory industrialization, capitalism vs. socialism, the Scramble for Africa, and imperial expansion in Asia.

topics.title: The Industrial Revolution: Technology, Labor and Ideologies
topics.description: Tracing the rise of steam power, urbanization, working-class movements, and Adam Smith vs. Karl Marx.

topics.title: The Age of Global Imperialism and Resistance
topics.description: Analyzing the Berlin Conference, colonial exploitation in the Congo, the British Raj in India, and the Boxer Rebellion in China.

modules.title: The World at War, Totalitarianism & the Cold War (1914–1991)
modules.description: Analyzing the causes of WWI, the Russian Revolution, fascism, WWII and the Holocaust, nuclear arms race, and decolonization.

topics.title: World War I, Trench Warfare and the Treaty of Versailles
topics.description: Investigating imperialism, militarism, secret alliances, the collapse of empires, and the flawed League of Nations.

topics.title: World War II, the Holocaust and the Cold War Order
topics.description: Analyzing fascist aggression, total war mobilization, the Nazi genocide, the atomic bomb, and the ideological US-Soviet standoff.
